data.one_liner: Low-level Dart library that parses text into URLs, emails, phone numbers and user tags.
data.what_it_does: The package scans a string and returns a list of elements representing plain text and detected links. It supports options to humanize URLs, remove www, and enable loose URL parsing. Custom linkifiers can be added for additional patterns.
use_when: You need to extract or transform links from plain text in a Dart or Flutter app
You want a lightweight, dependency‑free solution for link detection without UI widgets
avoid_when: You need ready‑made clickable link widgets (use flutter_linkify instead)
You require advanced parsing features like HTML or markdown handling
strengths: Highly customizable via options and custom linkifiers
weaknesses: Only provides parsing, no UI components
Limited to predefined link types unless you write custom linkifiers

alternatives.name: petitparser
alternatives.why_pick_it: A generic parsing library that can be used to build custom link parsers if you need more control or additional formats
